experiment: index source line starts for repeated AST span conversion
hypothesis: Syn span conversion repeatedly scans from byte zero to locate line starts. Reusing SourceFile's line-start index should reduce CPU while preserving span coordinates and memory use.
measurement: Quill check-subset front-end only; not a Cargo build or rustc comparison.
measurement_method: Seven fresh processes after the change; Linux wait4 rusage for process CPU and peak RSS; perf_counter wall time. Before medians use the immediately preceding shared-pool experiment on the same command and corpus.
decision: Keep the indexed span lookup. The repeated-run wall and CPU reductions are large, with effectively unchanged peak RSS. Span mapping and the 3454-body corpus acceptance check passed.
correctness_gate: Nightly workspace tests passed; all 3454 function bodies checked with zero diagnostics after the change. SourceFile span mapping has explicit multi-byte UTF-8, trailing newline, out-of-range, and line-zero coverage.
